meta.title: ShelfGuard — expiry tracking and stock control for retail stores
meta.description: Inventory management for grocery stores and chains: FEFO expiry tracking, AI auto-ordering, fiscal POS checkout (Checkbox), analytics, and a mobile app with a built-in scanner.

hero.badge: Inventory management for grocery stores and chains
hero.titleLine: Expiring stock shows up weeks out.
hero.description: ShelfGuard tracks every batch's expiry date using FEFO, tells you what and how much to order, prints fiscal receipts through ПРРО, and shows the status of every store on a single screen.
hero.imageAlt: ShelfGuard dashboard: batch statuses Safe, Warning, Critical, Expired, a list of items needing attention, and quick actions

problem.heading: Sound familiar?
problem.subheading: Three reasons grocery retail loses money every single day.

items.title: Write-offs eat your margin
items.text: Expired stock gets noticed once it's already sitting on the shelf — or once a customer returns it. Every such batch is money the store simply throws away.

items.title: Expiry dates live in notebooks and spreadsheets
items.text: Dates get logged by hand, checked on a walk through the store "whenever there's time." Human error guarantees something always slips through.

items.title: Orders placed by gut feel
items.text: Without real sales data, orders are guesswork. The result: either surplus stock that sits around and spoils, or empty shelves and lost sales.

features.heading: Everything a store needs, in one system
features.subheading: From receiving stock to a fiscal receipt. Modules turn on based on your type of business.

items.title: Expiry tracking (FEFO)
items.text: Every batch has its own expiry date and status: normal, warning, critical, expired. The system tells you what to sell first.

items.title: AI auto-ordering
items.text: AI analyzes sales, stock levels, and seasonality, and prepares an order suggestion every morning. All you do is review and confirm it.

items.title: Fiscal POS checkout
items.text: A full point-of-sale system fiscalized through Checkbox: receipts, shifts, Z-reports. Every sale deducts stock instantly — batch by batch, following FEFO.

items.title: Analytics and reports
items.text: Stock levels by zone and category, write-off losses, sales trends. Numbers for each store and for the whole chain.

items.title: B2B supplier marketplace
items.text: A supplier catalog with prices and terms. Orders go straight to the supplier from within the system — no calls, no messaging apps.

items.title: IoT temperature monitoring
items.text: Sensors in refrigerated display cases report temperature in real time. Any deviation triggers an instant alert, while the stock can still be saved.

items.title: Mobile app with a scanner
items.text: Receiving, write-offs, stocktaking, and sales — all from a phone. The barcode scanner works through the camera, no extra hardware needed.

items.title: Staff scheduling
items.text: Shift schedules for the store team live in the same system: who's working, where, and when — visible to both managers and staff in the app.

showcase.heading: See it in action
showcase.subheading: The actual interface — dark theme, real screens, nothing extra.

blocks.title: Store status at a glance

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subheading: There's no self-service signup — we onboard you personally, step by step.

steps.title: You submit a request
steps.text: Fill out a short form — we call you back, ask a few questions about your store, and show you the system live.

steps.title: We set it up and train your team
steps.text: We configure the system around your product range and workflows, import your items, and train your staff. No "figure out the docs yourself."

steps.title: You run everything from one screen
steps.text: Expiry dates, stock, orders, and checkout — all in one system. You spot problems before they cost you money.

audience.heading: Who it's for
audience.mainText: ShelfGuard is built first and foremost for grocery retail: short expiry dates, daily deliveries, dozens of categories. A single store or a whole chain — the system shows every location separately and all of them together.

secondary.title: Manufacturing
secondary.text: Recipes, production batches, finished-goods expiry dates.

secondary.title: Auto service shops
secondary.text: Parts, labor, work orders — a dedicated module.

audience.footer: The system is modular: we turn on only what your business needs.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.subheading: Cost depends on the number of stores and the modules you need — so we quote it individually.
pricing.priceText: Leave a request and we'll prepare a quote tailored to your business within one day.
included: Every module: expiry tracking, stock, checkout, analytics, marketplace
Mobile app with a barcode scanner
Setup tailored to your store plus product import
Team training — from cashiers to managers

items.a: No. The system runs in a browser on any computer, and the mobile app turns an ordinary smartphone into a barcode scanner. IoT temperature sensors are an optional module you can add if you want.
Usually a few business days: we configure the system for your store, import your product range, and train your team. For a chain with multiple locations, we agree on a timeline separately.

items.q: Does it work with fiscal registrars (ПРРО)?
items.a: Yes. Built-in integration with Checkbox: fiscal receipts, opening and closing shifts, Z-reports. Every sale automatically deducts stock following FEFO.

items.q: I have multiple stores — is that supported?
items.a: Yes, the system is built for chains from the ground up: each location is tracked separately, transfers between stores are recorded as documents, and consolidated analytics show the whole chain on one screen.
Yes. Connections are encrypted (HTTPS/TLS), each customer's data is isolated at the database level, access is protected by two-factor authentication (2FA), and backups run regularly.

items.q: Can I work from my phone?
items.a: Yes. The mobile app covers day-to-day operations: scanning, receiving deliveries, write-offs, stocktaking, and even checkout. Managers see the dashboard and notifications right on their phone.
